definitions: To move a boat through water using a paddle or paddles.
To walk with bare feet in shallow water.
To hit someone lightly with an open hand or a flat object, especially as a form of punishment.
To move one's hands or feet about in water.
examples: They decided to paddle their canoe across the lake.
The children love to paddle in the sea.
His father used to paddle him when he was naughty.
The dog started to paddle its paws in the stream.
